headline: Lumeria Maui appeal hearing delayed for more settlement talks

meeting.body: Lumeria Maui Appeal Continued to September
meeting.summary: The Board of Variance and Appeals delayed the Lumeria Maui appeal hearing so both sides can try one more settlement conference.
meeting.recap: The notice was for violating conditions 3 and 8 of a County ordinance.[[0:00:52]] At this hearing, the board could affirm or reverse the notice.[[0:01:18]] The appellant's attorney said the parties were not ready to proceed.[[0:02:51]] The attorney said the parties had held several settlement conferences and planned one more.[[0:02:56]] The attorney asked for a continuance (a delay of the hearing) and said the County's attorney did not object.[[0:03:22]] The chair said the board wanted to set a firm date and was willing to give it one more try.[[0:03:42]] The chair set September 10th as the deadline for documents.[[0:04:26]] The chair asked board members for any objections to moving the hearing date, and no objection is heard in the recording.[[0:04:47]] The new hearing will be at 1:30 p.m. on a Thursday.[[0:05:03]] The board's next meeting is July 9th.[[0:05:16]] The meeting adjourned at 1:41.[[0:05:19]]
meeting.next: The parties plan to hold one more settlement conference to try to resolve the appeal. The chair asked staff to put the new hearing date on the calendar.

moments.q: "We're willing to give it one more try"
Chair asks board members for objections to the new hearing date
